notes.title: Radio the Universe
notes.content:
Steam Nextfest is nearly over.

Thank you to everyone who tried the demo and/or wishlisted.

[b]Regarding event frequency: Steam asks developers for two "special" broadcast announcements to be featured on their festival page during Nextfest. I didn't have the foresight to spread them out over the week, which is why you may be seeing them all at once. This should be the last one from me for a while.[/b]

Demo status after Nextfest: Due to video errors which kept some people from trying the demo, it will remain available for now. There will be another patch soon.

Thank you.
